li: Primary and Grades 1 to 3, ages 6 to 10
Grades 4 to 8, ages 11 to 16, pointe from Grade 5
Pre-Professional, by audition, six days weekly
Adult Open, all levels, evenings and Saturday morning
p: Placement is by ability and readiness, never by age alone. A dancer moves up when the work is ready, and not before.
Trial classes are free. Take one, take three, decide afterward.
Term fees are billed by the term. There is no registration fee and no costume levy.
The youngest classes are about musicality, coordination, and the habit of listening. Formal barre work waits until the body is ready for it.
Parents are welcome in the observation area every week, not only on designated viewing days.
Soft shoes and any comfortable clothing. We will not sell you a uniform at this age.
Grades 1 through 8 follow the Vaganova progression, two to three classes weekly depending on level.
Pointe work begins at Grade 5 and only after individual assessment of ankle strength and growth-plate maturity.
Each grade closes with an informal class showing rather than an examination. Dancers are measured against last term, not against each other.
Six days weekly, including men's class, pointe, variations, conditioning, and character.
Entry is by audition each June. Places are limited to sixteen.
Academic scheduling support is available for dancers balancing school hours.
Absolute beginners are genuinely welcome. Roughly half of every Tuesday class has never taken ballet before.
Drop in or buy a card of ten. Nothing expires.
Wear whatever lets you move. Socks are fine for the first few weeks.
